name: Awareness of the outside and interaction with it
vision_statement: The AI knows what is outside the system and can interact with it: it brings in knowledge a reader can check, uses the right tool for each kind of need, asks a model through one measured path and keeps its own research current.
opportunities: Tool categories as solutions, with integrations as their implementations, go beyond bringing in a web search, and a category can gain a better integration without any product rewriting its code. The models the hub asks and the freshness of its research change with the outside too.
solution_coherence: World is how the system learns what is outside it and acts on it. Science returns observations of public research that a reader can cite. Tools lets the AI use the tool of a category through Web Search, File Editing, Connected System Operations, Delegated Agent Sessions or Personal Data Locations. File Editing makes its one-call edit through Vendor Model Caller at the tier that Model Tier Chooser picks. Model Plumbing is how every part asks a model, and it picks the model for each tier through Model Tier Chooser and asks that model through Model Call. Model Call reaches each vendor through Vendor Model Caller, which steps to the next provider when one fails. Learning keeps the research current by reading dates through Research Freshness Reader.
